query: How do I replace a nightlight bulb?

goal.title: Replace the bedside lamp bulb
goal.description: Unplug the bedside lamp, unscrew and remove its installed bulb, screw in another bulb, align the shade, reconnect the power plug and turn the lamp on.
goal.final_state: The replacement bulb is seated beneath the black shade and visibly illuminated; the removed bulb remains on the bedside table.

procedure.description: Approach the wall outlet, grasp the upper black power plug with the right hand and pull it free. Leave the separate lower plug inserted.
Walk to the bedside table and look down through the black lamp shade at the bulb. Briefly touch the shade and its inner support, withdraw the hand, then reach toward the bulb.

Grip the installed bulb with the right hand and repeatedly rotate and regrip it to unscrew it. Lift its threaded base clear of the socket, lower it beside the giraffe ornament on the bedside table and release it.

Pick up the other bulb from the table and turn it between both hands. Raise it above the shade, lower its screw base into the lamp socket and rotate it with the right hand. Briefly release and regrip, then continue turning it repeatedly until it stays seated.

Release the bulb, hold opposite sides of the black shade and straighten it. Let go, step toward the wall outlet and lift the loose plug. Turn and align its prongs with the upper receptacle and press it fully in.

Release the connected plug and return to the lamp. Reach around the lamp below the shade; the control itself is hidden. The installed bulb becomes visibly illuminated around82s. Withdraw and step back while the lamp remains on.
